title: Scholarship Application Checklist
subtitle: Capture award cycle, eligibility source, application evidence, and review rubric; confirm conflict disclosure and award notice.
description: Scholarship Application records award cycle, eligibility source, application evidence, review rubric, conflict disclosure, and award notice. Scholarship Application evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this scholarship application stage-gated verification when staff must document award cycle and eligibility source. Reconcile application evidence, review rubric, conflict disclosure, and award notice before the scholarship application handoff. Use the program rules, eligibility documents, transcript or work evidence, rubric scores, reviewer conflict statement, award ledger, decision notice, and acceptance receipt. Ask the assigned scholarship application reviewer to confirm award cycle against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Scholarship Application starting details
sections.guidance: Identify award cycle, eligibility source, application materials, rubric evidence, reviewer conflict disclosure, decision rationale, and award notification.

sections.title: Scholarship Application checks and corrections review
sections.guidance: Check current scholarship application facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Scholarship Application required checks
items: Award cycle is identified for this record
Eligibility source matches the current request or source
Application evidence is ready for point-of-use staff
Review rubric limits or questions are resolved
Conflict disclosure is communicated to the responsible person
Award notice is confirmed at handoff

blocks.label: Scholarship Application failed or pending items

sections.title: Scholarship Application readiness
sections.guidance: Hold scholarship application readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Scholarship Application reviewer receipt

fields.label: Responsible teacher or program coordinator and date

blocks.guidance: Scholarship Application receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
